description: This file contains the implementation and metadata definitions for various loss functions in the PyTorch library, including smooth L1 loss, MSE loss, cosine embedding loss, hinge embedding loss, triplet margin loss, margin ranking loss, binary cross entropy, KL divergence, and their associated backward functions. It includes metadata declarations, function definitions, dispatch macros, and external dependencies.

methods.name: at::Tensor apply_loss_reduction(const at::Tensor & unreduced,int64_t reduction)
methods.description: Applies the specified reduction method (mean, sum, or none) to the unreduced loss tensor.

methods.name: smooth_l1_loss
methods.description: Meta function that sets up the output tensor for the smooth L1 loss based on input tensors, reduction, and beta.

methods.name: mse_loss
methods.description: Meta function for mean squared error loss calculation setup.
